name: apxUSD
oneLiner: apxUSD is Apyx's dollar stablecoin backed by preferred shares of Digital Asset Treasury companies plus a cash and T-Bill buffer, mintable 1:1.
collateral: Preferred shares issued by Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs) — variable-rate, dividend-bearing preferred equity from companies holding digital assets (e.g., Strategy STRC, Strive SATA), held in excess of apxUSD outstanding, plus a cash and short-term U.S. Treasury Bill buffer (incl. USDC) for liquidity; redemptions settle in USDC, with preferred-share positions sold to USDC under stress
pegMechanism: 1:1 collateral deposit and redemption through the Apyx protocol; Protocol-Owned Liquidity (POL) provides a stability buffer during market stress

applicabilityBasis.summary: apxUSD has stablecoin-like mint/redeem mechanics, but collateral and issuer materials describe preferred-share and RWA investment exposure.

genius.notes: apxUSD is stablecoin-adjacent, but its preferred-share collateral makes GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved.

mintAuthority.summary: apxUSD minting is routed through Apyx's MinterV0 contract, where an m-of-n minter submits EIP-712 signed orders and AccessManager delays/permissions gate the eventual apxUSD mint.

controls.label: Apyx MinterV0 signed-order mint path

routeChecks.signingModel: EIP-712 signed orders submitted by an m-of-n minter wallet
routeChecks.rateLimits: MinterV0 includes rate limiting and AccessManager-delayed execution per Apyx contract documentation
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: AccessManager manages mint permissions; live role holders were not independently enumerated

controls.evidence: Apyx technical documentation describes MinterV0 handling apxUSD minting through EIP-712 signed orders, rate limits, AccessManager integration, and whitelisted beneficiary checks.

review.evidence: Apyx docs say whitelisted users deposit collateral and receive newly minted apxUSD; Apyx's contract documentation identifies MinterV0 as the mint route using EIP-712 signed orders, an m-of-n minter wallet, AccessManager checks, and beneficiary screening.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate live MinterV0, AccessManager role holders, rate limits, and any pause/upgrade admins before raising confidence.
